propositions.name: aether_continuous_incompressible
propositions.statement: The aether is a continuous, homogeneous, incompressible medium endowed with inertia and elasticity purely rotational.
propositions.quote: the æther to be a continuous, homogeneous, and incompressible medium, endowed with inertia and with elasticity purely rotational

propositions.name: electrons_point_singularities
propositions.statement: Electrons exist as point-singularities or centres of intrinsic strain in the medium which can move about under mutual actions.
propositions.quote: point-singularities in the uniform æther which are taken to be the basis of matter, and at any rate are the basis of its electrical phenomena

propositions.name: atoms_aggregations_of_electrons
propositions.statement: Atoms of matter are aggregations of electrons in stable orbital motion.
propositions.quote: atoms of matter are in whole or in part aggregations of electrons in stable orbital motion

propositions.name: actions_transmitted_through_medium
propositions.statement: Actions between material atoms take place through the intervention of a medium rather than as bare forces at a distance.
propositions.quote: a medium through whose intervention these actions between the material atoms take place

propositions.name: aether_inertia_same_kind
propositions.statement: The aether has the property of inertia, of the same kind as ordinary matter possesses.
propositions.quote: the same kind as ordinary matter possesses, for there can hardly be a more general kind

propositions.name: aether_rotational_elasticity_no_shape
propositions.statement: The aether has perfect fluidity as regards form, but elastic resistance to rotational displacement.
propositions.quote: there is perfect fluidity as regards form, but elastic resistance to rotational displacement

propositions.name: aether_no_volume_elasticity
propositions.statement: The aether does not possess the property of elasticity of volume that exists in molecularly constituted matter.
propositions.quote: no phenomenon has been discovered which would allow us to assume that the property of elasticity of volume, which necessarily exists in any molecularly constituted medium such as matter, is present in the æther at all

propositions.name: absolute_space_necessary
propositions.statement: A definite spacial framework, fixed or moving, to which motion is referred, is a necessary part of any dynamical theory.
propositions.quote: a definite space, or spacial framework fixed or moving, to which motion is referred, is a necessary part of any dynamical theory

propositions.name: electric_force_produces_rotation
propositions.statement: Electric force produces rotation of the aether proportional to its intensity, the motion of the aether being otherwise irrotational.
propositions.quote: the motion of our rotational æther in the previous papers is irrotational except where electric force exists which produces rotation proportional to its intensity

propositions.name: aether_inertia_elasticity_tuned_to_radiation_speed
propositions.statement: The medium has a high coefficient of inertia and an extremely high elasticity in order to conserve the ascertained velocity of radiation.
propositions.quote: we have been compelled to assume a high coefficient of inertia of the medium, and therefore an extremely high elasticity in order to conserve the ascertained velocity of radiation

propositions.name: electrons_persist_until_destroyed
propositions.statement: Electrons persist until destroyed by an extraneous process, and mutual destruction of two complementary electrons by direct impact has infinitely small probability.
propositions.quote: mutual destruction of two complementary electrons by direct impact is an occurrence of infinitely small probability

propositions.name: actual_optical_reflexion_laws_fixed
propositions.statement: There are actual laws of optical reflexion that a valid theory must reproduce, and an ordinary elastic solid medium would give different laws.
propositions.quote: the laws of optical reflexion would be different from the actual ones

propositions.name: electron_force_equals_charge_times_field
propositions.statement: For each electron at rest, the ponderomotive force on it is equal to its charge multiplied by the intensity of the electric field where it is situated.
propositions.quote: for each electron at rest, this force is equal to its charge multiplied by the intensity of the electric field where it is situated

propositions.name: forces_not_ordinary_solid_transmission
propositions.statement: The attractions between material bodies are not transmitted by the aether in the way that mechanical tractions are transmitted by an ordinary solid.
propositions.quote: The attractions between material bodies are therefore not transmitted by the æther in the way that mechanical tractions are transmitted by an ordinary solid

propositions.name: forces_not_action_at_distance
propositions.statement: The attractions between material bodies are not direct actions at a distance either.
propositions.quote: for it is electric force that is so transmitted: but neither are they direct actions at a distance

propositions.name: mutual_forces_from_potential_energy_function
propositions.statement: The mutual forces of a steady system are derived from a single analytical function which is its available potential energy.
propositions.quote: the mutual forces of such a system are derived from a single analytical function which is its available potential energy

propositions.name: aether_simple_homogeneous
propositions.statement: The aether is a presumably simple and homogeneous medium, unlike matter which is complicated in its ultimate dynamical constitution.
propositions.quote: our best chance is to try to approach it through the presumably simple and homogeneous æther in which it subsists

propositions.name: aether_transmits_electric_force_across_vacuum
propositions.statement: Displacement of the aether transmits electric force across a vacuum, and this in turn produces polarization in the molecules of a material dielectric.
propositions.quote: the displacement of the æther which transmits electric force across a vacuum as producing polarization in the molecules of a material dielectric

propositions.name: aether_not_matter
propositions.statement: The aether is not matter and need not obey the laws of the dynamics of matter, provided it obeys another scheme of dynamical laws consistent among themselves.
propositions.quote: The æther not being matter, it need not obey the laws of the dynamics of matter, provided it obey another scheme of dynamical laws consistent among themselves

propositions.name: absolute_rest_frame_is_aether
propositions.statement: The spacial framework in absolute rest, introduced by Newton, is in fact the quiescent underlying aether.
propositions.quote: the spacial framework in absolute rest, which was introduced by Newton and was probably a main source of the great advance in abstract dynamics originated by the Principia , is in fact the quiescent underlying æther

propositions.name: euclidean_space_relations
propositions.statement: The Euclidean relations of measurements in space are part of the ultimate scheme of mental representation of the actual physical world.
propositions.quote: the existing Euclidean relations of measurements in space (which also might a priori be different from what they are) as part of the ultimate scheme of mental representation of the actual physical world

propositions.name: action_reaction_balance
propositions.statement: The energy principle involves the principle of the balance of action and reaction, in its most general form.
propositions.quote: the energy principle thus involves the principle of the balance of action and reaction, in its most general form

propositions.name: stress_self_conjugate_for_molecular_matter
propositions.statement: For a rectangular element of ordinary solid matter, the tangential components of internal tractions must be self-conjugate, as in the ordinary theory of elasticity.
propositions.quote: for a rectangular element of ordinary solid matter the tangential components of these tractions must be self-conjugate, as they are taken to be in the ordinary theory of elasticity

propositions.name: propagation_requires_inertia_and_elasticity
propositions.statement: Propagation of an effect in time requires inertia and elasticity for its mathematical expression.
propositions.quote: This propagation in time requires inertia and elasticity for its mathematical expression

propositions.name: gravitation_needs_medium_explanation
propositions.statement: A theory that explains atoms of matter as singularities in the aether must look for an explanation of gravitation by means of the properties of that medium, not as fundamental action at a distance.
propositions.quote: it cannot avail itself of Cotes 's dogma that gravitation at a distance is itself as fundamental and intelligible as any explanation thereof could be

propositions.name: gravitation_not_static_stress
propositions.statement: Gravitation cannot be transmitted by statical stress, because that would make the mutual forces of the atoms resist approach rather than produce attraction.
propositions.quote: and hence the mutual forces of the atoms would resist approach

propositions.name: gravitation_isotropic_electron_property
propositions.statement: Gravitation must belong to the ultimate constituents of matter, the electrons, and must be isotropic all round each of them.
propositions.quote: As gravitation must belong to the ultimate constituents of matter, that is on this theory to the electrons, and must be isotropic all round each of them

propositions.name: maxwell_equations_verified_by_experiment
propositions.statement: Maxwell's equations of the electric field in free space form a sufficient description of the free aether and have been verified by experiment.
propositions.quote: so far as they are electric they may be based directly on Maxwell 's equations of the electric field in free space , which form a sufficient description of the free æther, and have been verified by experiment

propositions.name: polarization_deduced_from_molecules_relation_to_aether
propositions.statement: The polarization of material bodies with the resulting forcive is deduced from the relation of their molecules to the aethereal medium in which they have their being.
propositions.quote: the polarization of material bodies with the resulting forcive are deduced from the relation of their molecules to this medium in which they have their being

propositions.name: faraday_law_holds
propositions.statement: The line integral of electric force round a circuit in uniform motion with the matter is equal to the time-rate of diminution of the magnetic flux through its aperture.
propositions.quote: the line integral of electric force round a circuit in uniform motion with the matter is equal to the time-rate of diminution of the magnetic flux through its aperture

propositions.name: ampere_law_holds
propositions.statement: The line integral of the magnetic force round any circuit is equal to 4 pi times the total current that flows through its aperture.
propositions.quote: the line integral of the magnetic force round any circuit is equal to 4π times the total current that flows through its aperture

propositions.name: convection_no_charge_separation
propositions.statement: Mere convection of the polarized medium does not produce separation of free electricity.
propositions.quote: mere convection of the polarized medium does not produce separation of free electricity

propositions.name: charge_carried_by_matter_in_steady_state
propositions.statement: The electrons constituting electric densities are wholly carried on by the matter whenever a steady state is attained.
propositions.quote: the electrons constituting electric densities being wholly carried on by the matter whenever a steady state is attained

propositions.name: rowland_experiment_consistency
propositions.statement: The carrying of electric densities by moving matter in a steady state is a necessary consequence of the theory that agrees with Rowland's experiments on convection currents.
propositions.quote: This necessary consequence of the theory is in keeping with Rowland's classical experiments on convection currents

propositions.name: fresnel_law_velocity_alteration
propositions.statement: The alteration of the velocity of propagation of radiation in a moving material medium follows Fresnel's law.
propositions.quote: leading to Fresnel's law of alteration of the velocity of propagation

propositions.name: body_shrinks_in_direction_of_motion
propositions.statement: A body in uniform motion through the aether is shrunk in the direction of its velocity, in a ratio depending on the velocity.
propositions.quote: one consequence of the motion thus being that the body is shrunk in the direction of its velocity v in the ratio

propositions.name: contraction_explains_michelson_null_result
propositions.statement: The shrinking of a moving body confirms the hypothesis of FitzGerald and Lorentz, put forward to explain the negative result of Michelson's optical experiments.
propositions.quote: it will confirm the hypothesis of FitzGerald and Lorentz , to which they were led as the ultimate resource for the explanation of the negative result of Michelson 's optical experiments

propositions.name: molecule_constitution_wholly_electric
propositions.statement: The constitution of a molecule is wholly electric, as represented by the theory of electrons.
propositions.quote: and conversely it will involve evidence that the constitution of a molecule is wholly electric, as here represented

propositions.name: no_mechanical_force_at_electron_level
propositions.statement: In the complete survey of individual atoms there is no such entity as mechanical force, any more than there is on a free vortex ring in fluid.
propositions.quote: for in the present complete survey of the individual atoms there is no such entity as mechanical force, any more than there is on a free vortex ring in fluid

propositions.name: like_magnetic_poles_repel
propositions.statement: Two steady magnetic poles of like sign repel each other.
propositions.quote: Two steady magnetic poles of like sign would repel each other

propositions.name: internal_disturbance_causes_radiation
propositions.statement: It is only when the steady orbital motions of the molecule are disturbed that the resulting vibration gives rise to radiation by which internal energy is lost.
propositions.quote: it is only when these steady motions are disturbed that the resulting vibration gives rise to radiation by which some of the internal energy is lost

propositions.name: spectral_lines_independent_of_temperature
propositions.statement: Change of temperature has no influence on the positions of the lines in a spectrum.
propositions.quote: this explains why change of temperature has no influence on the positions of the lines in a spectrum

propositions.name: specific_heat_ratio_bound
propositions.statement: The ratio of the specific heats in a gas must lie between 1 and five-thirds.
propositions.quote: The ratio of the specific heats in a gas must still lie between 1 and

propositions.name: maxwell_boltzmann_distribution_fails
propositions.statement: On this view the postulates of the Maxwell-Boltzmann theorem on the distribution of internal energy in gases would not obtain, since the thermal energy of the molecule would not be expressible as a sum of squares.
propositions.quote: On this view the postulates of the Maxwell-Boltzmann theorem on the distribution of the internal energy in gases would not obtain, for the thermal energy of the molecule would not be expressible as a sum of squares

propositions.name: convection_more_efficient_than_radiation
propositions.statement: Convection by a gas, even when highly rarefied, is much more efficient in the transfer of heat than radiation.
propositions.quote: it would not appear why convection by a gas, even when highly rarefied, is so much more efficient in the transfer of heat than radiation

propositions.name: chemical_affinity_persists_near_zero_temperature
propositions.statement: The energies of chemical affinity exist all the time in probably undiminished strength even as translatory motion diminishes toward the zero of temperature.
propositions.quote: the energies of affinity exist all the time in probably undiminished strength
